map.多囊卵巢(PCOS)诊断标准器 使用指南: Polycystic Ovary (PCOS) Diagnostic Criteria User Guide
map.基于鹿特丹标准(需满足2/3)评估PCOS，结合表型分类和代谢风险分层: Assesses PCOS against the Rotterdam criteria (two of three required), combining phenotype classification and metabolic risk stratification
map.月经稀发合并痤疮/多毛的病因筛查。: Screening for the cause of infrequent menstruation with acne or hirsutism.
map.不孕评估中的排卵功能与卵巢形态判断。: Assessment of ovulatory function and ovarian morphology in infertility workups.
map.代谢并发症（胰岛素抵抗、NAFLD）风险初筛。: First-pass screen for metabolic complications (insulin resistance, NAFLD).
map.：月经稀发 + 总睾酮升高 + 超声双侧卵巢多囊样改变（每侧≥12 个小卵泡）：: Infrequent menstruation plus elevated total testosterone plus bilateral polycystic ovarian changes on ultrasound (at least 12 small follicles per side): two of the three items are met, so PCOS is diagnosed (phenotype A or B), after excluding thyroid disease, hyperprolactinemia and congenital adrenal hyperplasia and similar causes.
map.鹿特丹与雄激素过多协会标准区别？: What is the difference between the Rotterdam and Androgen Excess Society criteria?
map.鹿特丹要求 3 项中 2 项，敏感性更高；AES 更强调高雄激素为核心。两者均需: Rotterdam requires 2 of 3 items, giving higher sensitivity, while the AES puts more weight on hyperandrogenism as the core. Both require excluding other causes of hyperandrogenism or ovulatory dysfunction.
map.表型分类有什么意义？: What is the point of phenotype classification?
map.A（排卵+高雄+PCOM 全有）代谢风险最高，D（仅排卵+PCOM）最低；表型指: Type A (ovulation plus hyperandrogenism plus PCOM) carries the highest metabolic risk and type D (ovulation plus PCOM only) the lowest; the phenotype guides the intensity of metabolic screening and fertility management.
